a: Prefer allowlists of accepted values over blocklists of bad ones.
Validate JSON with schemas (JSON Schema, Zod, Pydantic).
Bound string and array lengths to prevent resource abuse.
Be explicit about types; unexpected coercion causes bugs.
Allow only http/https; block internal IPs to reduce SSRF.
Syntax-check then verify via OTP; perfect RFC validation is hard.
Check size, magic bytes, and extension; store outside web root.
Normalize Unicode and reject unexpected control characters.
If validation is uncertain, reject the input.
